messages:
Ari (eng): 11 minutes to go. Quick logistics thread: mic check, slide order tweak, and recording fallback.
Maya (prod): Leadership asked to shift the roadmap Q&A to the end by 4 mins. Can we shorten the demo by 4?
Omar (design): I can collapse one demo slide and skip the breakpoint animation. Uploading new deck now.
Jules (infra): Caption service had a 10s stall earlier. I've bumped the pod and will keep metrics on a 5s cadence.
Rina (comms): Please confirm speaker list and pronouns. I need that for the caption feed and caption metadata.
Ari (eng): Mic check: presenters drop a quick "here" so I can confirm levels. Also note: if OBS crashes, fallback is record-only on the machine.
allhands-bot: Recording scheduled to start in 2 minutes. Link: https://zoom.company/all-hands
Omar (design): Deck: drive.company/allhands/quick_trim_v1.pptx — removed animation and merged two slides.
Jules (infra): If OBS needs a restart, run:
```
pkill obs || true
sleep 1
obs --startrecording --minimize-to-tray &
```
Expect ~10s gap. I'll watch captions logs: `tail -n 100 /var/log/captions/current.log | grep WARN`
Maya (prod): I'll collect Qs in the GDoc; drop urgent ones here. Leadership will take two prioritized questions at the end.
Rina (comms): Posting speaker roster now and will pin after the meeting. Setting transcript retention to 72h.
Ari (eng): All set from my side. If network buffer rises >20s, we flip to recorder-only (Jules + me).
Jules (infra): Monitoring network and caption latency.
Maya (prod): Thanks everyone. See you in the room in 8. Please keep replies here minimal unless AV issues pop. :white_check_mark:
